license_required.quote: The certificate to practice podiatric medicine authorizes the holder to practice podiatric medicine.

issuing_authority.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine to each applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter.

name.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine to each applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter.

type.quote: Each member of the board, except the public members, shall be appointed from persons having all of the following qualifications

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (D.P.M.) from an approved school or college of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: Each applicant for a certificate to practice podiatric medicine shall show by an official transcript or other official evidence satisfactory to the board that is submitted directly to the board by the academic institution that he or she has successfully completed a medical curriculum extending over a period of at least four academic years, or 32 months of actual instruction, in a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the board.

accrediting_body.quote: The board may only approve a podiatric residency that it determines meets all of the following requirements: (2) Is approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.

required.quote: In addition to any other requirements of this chapter, before a certificate to practice podiatric medicine may be issued, each applicant shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board, submitted directly to the board by the sponsoring institution, that he or she has satisfactorily completed at least two years of postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training in a general acute care hospital approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.

duration.quote: at least two years of postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training in a general acute care hospital

kind.quote: postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME) Parts I, II, and III
exams.quote: The applicant, within the past 10 years, has passed parts I, II, and III of the examination administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners of the United States or has passed a written examination that is recognized by the board to be the equivalent in content to the examination administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners of the United States.

exams.name: Oral and practical examination
exams.quote: The applicant has passed within the past 10 years any oral and practical examination that may be required of all applicants by the board to ascertain clinical competence.

interval_years.quote: Certificates to practice podiatric medicine shall expire at midnight on the last day of the birth month of the licensee during the second year of a two-year term.

required.quote: In order to ensure the continuing competence of persons licensed to practice podiatric medicine, the board shall adopt and administer regulations requiring continuing education of those licensees.

available.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine by credentialing if the applicant has submitted directly to the board from the credentialing organizations verification that they are licensed as a doctor of podiatric medicine in any other state

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state, have graduated from an approved school of podiatric medicine, have passed Part III of NBPME or equivalent, have completed postgraduate training approved by Council on Podiatric Medical Education, and have passed any required oral and practical examination.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine by credentialing if the applicant has submitted directly to the board from the credentialing organizations verification that they are licensed as a doctor of podiatric medicine in any other state and meets all of the following requirements

exists.quote: Each member of the board, except the public members, shall be appointed from persons having all of the following qualifications

national_certification.value: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME)
national_certification.quote: The applicant, within the past 10 years, has passed parts I, II, and III of the examination administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners of the United States

regulatory_model.quote: The certificate to practice podiatric medicine authorizes the holder to practice podiatric medicine.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine to each applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who uses in any sign or in any advertisement or otherwise, the word or words "doctor of podiatric medicine," "doctor of podiatry," "podiatric doctor," "podiatric surgeon," "D.P.M.," "podiatrist," "foot specialist," or any other term or terms or any letters indicating or implying that they are a doctor of podiatric medicine, or that they practice podiatric medicine, or hold themselves out as practicing podiatric medicine or foot correction as defined in Section 2472, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

title_protection.quote: Any person who uses in any sign or in any advertisement or otherwise, the word or words "doctor of podiatric medicine," "doctor of podiatry," "podiatric doctor," "podiatric surgeon," "D.P.M.," "podiatrist," "foot specialist," or any other term or terms or any letters indicating or implying that they are a doctor of podiatric medicine, or that they practice podiatric medicine, or hold themselves out as practicing podiatric medicine or foot correction as defined in Section 2472, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: The certificate to practice podiatric medicine authorizes the holder to practice podiatric medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has committed no acts or crimes constituting grounds for denial of a certificate under Division 1.5 (commencing with Section 475).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action taken by another podiatric licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board determines that no disciplinary action has been taken against the applicant by any podiatric licensing authority and that the applicant has not been the subject of adverse judgments or settlements resulting from the practice of podiatric medicine that the board determines constitutes evidence of a pattern of negligence or incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of negligence or incompetence in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant has not been the subject of adverse judgments or settlements resulting from the practice of podiatric medicine that the board determines constitutes evidence of a pattern of negligence or incompetence

citations.cite: California Business and Professions Code Division 2, Chapter 5, Article 22 (Sections 2460-2499.8)

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot
definition_quote.quote: "podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines
drug_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may independently prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines, consistent with recommendations adopted pursuant to Section 120164 of the Health and Safety Code, to persons three years of age or older.

citations.cite: California Business and Professions Code Section 2472
California Business and Professions Code Section 2473

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot

amputation_authorized.quote: Perform a partial amputation of the foot no further proximal than the Chopart's joint.

anesthesia_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine shall not administer an anesthetic other than local. If an anesthetic other than local is required for any procedure, the anesthetic shall be administered by another licensed health care practitioner who is authorized to administer the required anesthetic within the scope of their practice.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may do the following: (A) Perform surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons at the level of the ankle pursuant to subdivision (e).

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may perform surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons at the level of the ankle only in the following locations: (1) A licensed general acute care hospital, as defined in Section 1250 of the Health and Safety Code. (2) A licensed surgical clinic... (3) An ambulatory surgical center that is certified to participate in the Medicare Program

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: a doctor of podiatric medicine with training or experience in wound care may treat ulcers resulting from local and systemic etiologies on the leg no further proximal than the tibial tubercle.

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: a doctor of podiatric medicine with training or experience in wound care may treat ulcers resulting from local and systemic etiologies on the leg no further proximal than the tibial tubercle.

vaccination_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may independently prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines, consistent with recommendations adopted pursuant to Section 120164 of the Health and Safety Code, to persons three years of age or older.

hospital_privileges_nondiscrimination.quote: It is the policy of this state that a doctor of podiatric medicine shall be classified or treated as a doctor of podiatric medicine and shall not be classified or treated as an ancillary provider or other allied health professional in any health care setting or insurance reimbursement structure for any purpose.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to prevent a regularly matriculated student undertaking a course of professional instruction in an approved college or school of podiatric medicine from participating in training beyond the scope of podiatric medicine under the supervision of a physician and surgeon who holds a medical doctor or doctor of osteopathy degree whenever and wherever prescribed as part of his or her course of study.

assistant_surgeon_role_authorized.quote: Perform services under the direct supervision of a physician and surgeon, as an assistant at surgery, in surgical procedures that are otherwise beyond the scope of practice of a doctor of podiatric medicine.
